package templates

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/i18n"
	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/web/templates/ui"
)

// ExampleResourceItem is the view row for example_resources.
// The handler maps query rows onto it, so this package depends on nothing
// generated and adding a column cannot silently change what the table renders.
type ExampleResourceItem struct {
	ID        int64
	Name      string
	CreatedAt time.Time
}

// ExampleResourcesListData is the read surface state.
// One page of rows, the search term, the pager position, the base URL every
// control links back to, and the form that shares the page.
//
// Writable marks the surface whose route scope owns the mutations — the app
// page for a tenant-scoped table, the staff page for a platform one — so the
// other surface renders the same table with no write controls. Admin marks the
// staff layout, where showing a control additionally requires the viewer's
// write role.
type ExampleResourcesListData struct {
	Items      []ExampleResourceItem
	Query      string
	Page       int
	TotalPages int
	BaseURL    string
	Writable   bool
	Admin      bool
	Form       ExampleResourceFormData
}

// ExampleResourceFormData is the create/edit form state. ID 0 is a create, and WriteURL
// is the prefix the form posts to, which is not always the page's own URL.
type ExampleResourceFormData struct {
	ID       int64
	Name     string
	NameErr  string
	WriteURL string
}

// exampleResourcesWritable is the one place that decides whether write controls render.
// Default deny: an unset context inside the admin layout renders read-only, so
// a support-role viewer sees the table and not controls that would 403.
func exampleResourcesWritable(ctx context.Context, d ExampleResourcesListData) bool {
	if !d.Writable {
		return false
	}
	if d.Admin {
		return AdminWrite(ctx)
	}
	return true
}

templ ExampleResourcesPage(d ExampleResourcesListData) {
	@ui.PageHeader(ui.PageHeaderOpts{Title: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.title")})
	if exampleResourcesWritable(ctx, d) {
		@ExampleResourceForm(d.Form)
	}
	// The search box stays OUTSIDE the swap target: it morphs the table
	// container on every keystroke, and a control inside the box it replaces is
	// re-created mid-word, which loses the caret.
	@ui.TableToolbar(ui.TableToolbarOpts{Label: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.toolbar_label")}) {
		@exampleResourcesSearch(d)
	}
	<div id="example-resource-table-container">
		@ExampleResourcesTable(d)
	</div>
}

// AdminExampleResourcesPage is the staff surface. It is the write surface for a platform
// table and a read surface for a tenant-scoped one; the handler says which by
// setting Writable, and exampleResourcesWritable adds the write-role check.
templ AdminExampleResourcesPage(d ExampleResourcesListData) {
	@ui.PageHeader(ui.PageHeaderOpts{Title: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.admin_title")})
	if exampleResourcesWritable(ctx, d) {
		@ExampleResourceForm(d.Form)
	}
	@ui.TableToolbar(ui.TableToolbarOpts{Label: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.toolbar_label")}) {
		@exampleResourcesSearch(d)
	}
	<div id="example-resource-table-container">
		@ExampleResourcesTable(d)
	</div>
}

templ exampleResourcesSearch(d ExampleResourcesListData) {
	@ui.SearchInput(ui.SearchInputOpts{
		Name: "q", Value: d.Query,
		Placeholder: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.search_placeholder"),
		AriaLabel:   i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.search_label"),
		GetURL:      d.BaseURL, Target: "#example-resource-table-container",
		IndicatorID: "example-resource-search-indicator",
	})
}

// ExampleResourcesTable is the search and pager fragment.
// The CONTENTS of the table container, never the box itself: both controls swap
// innerMorph, so a fragment repeating its own wrapper would leave a second
// element carrying the same id.
templ ExampleResourcesTable(d ExampleResourcesListData) {
	@ui.DataTable(exampleResourcesTable(ctx, d)) {
		for _, item := range d.Items {
			<tr id={ fmt.Sprintf("example-resource-%d", item.ID) } data-testid="example-resource-row">
				<td class="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{ item.Name }</td>
				<td class="px-4 py-3 text-fg-muted">{ item.CreatedAt.Format("Jan 2, 2006") }</td>
				if exampleResourcesWritable(ctx, d) {
					<td class="px-4 py-3">
						<div class="card-actions">
							@ui.ButtonLink(ui.ButtonLinkOpts{
								Label: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.edit"),
								Href:  fmt.Sprintf("%s?edit=%d", d.BaseURL, item.ID),
								Size:  ui.SizeXS,
							})
							// The request rides on the dialog's confirm control,
							// so the delete contract (closest tr, outerHTML,
							// 200-empty) is unchanged while the prompt stays
							// translatable and assertable. hx-confirm calls
							// window.confirm and can be neither.
							@ui.ConfirmAction(ui.ConfirmActionOpts{
								ID: fmt.Sprintf("example-resource-delete-%d", item.ID),
								// The row's subject is in the trigger's name:
								// forty controls all called "Delete" are
								// indistinguishable to a screen reader.
								TriggerLabel: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.delete_row", item.Name),
								TriggerIcon:  ui.IconDelete,
								Title:        i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.delete_title"),
								Message:      i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.delete_confirm"),
								ConfirmLabel: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.delete_action"),
								CancelLabel:  i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.cancel"),
								Kind:         ui.KindDanger,
								HX: ui.HX{
									Delete: fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", d.BaseURL, item.ID),
									Target: "closest tr", Swap: "outerHTML",
								},
							})
						</div>
					</td>
				}
			</tr>
		}
	}
}

// exampleResourcesTable assembles the list and its slots.
// Empty and Pagination are passed in every state: a caller that renders the
// table only when rows exist takes the pager away with the rows.
func exampleResourcesTable(ctx context.Context, d ExampleResourcesListData) ui.DataTableOpts {
	columns := []ui.Column{
		{Key: "name", Label: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.col_name")},
		{Key: "created", Label: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.col_created")},
	}
	if exampleResourcesWritable(ctx, d) {
		columns = append(columns, ui.Column{Key: "actions", Label: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.col_actions"), Align: ui.AlignEnd})
	}
	return ui.DataTableOpts{
		Caption:       i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.caption"),
		HiddenCaption: true,
		Columns:       columns,
		RowCount:      len(d.Items),
		Empty:         exampleResourcesEmpty(d),
		Pagination:    exampleResourcesPager(d),
		Attrs:         ui.Attrs{ID: "example-resource-table", TestID: "example-resource-table"},
	}
}

// exampleResourcesEmpty separates "nothing exists yet" from
// "your search matched nothing". Offering "add your first one" to somebody
// whose query missed is the wrong answer to the wrong question.
templ exampleResourcesEmpty(d ExampleResourcesListData) {
	if d.Query != "" {
		@ui.EmptyState(ui.EmptyStateOpts{
			Level: 2, Variant: ui.EmptyInline, Filtered: true,
			Title:      i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.filtered_empty_title"),
			Body:       i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.filtered_empty_body", d.Query),
			ClearURL:   d.BaseURL,
			ClearLabel: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.clear_search"),
			Target:     "#example-resource-table-container",
		})
	} else {
		@ui.EmptyState(ui.EmptyStateOpts{
			Level: 2, Variant: ui.EmptyInline,
			Title: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.empty_title"),
			Body:  i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.empty_body"),
		})
	}
}

templ exampleResourcesPager(d ExampleResourcesListData) {
	@ui.Pagination(ui.PaginationOpts{
		Page: d.Page, TotalPages: d.TotalPages,
		BaseURL: d.BaseURL + "?q=" + d.Query, Target: "#example-resource-table-container",
		Numbered: true,
		Labels:   exampleResourcesPagerLabels(ctx),
	})
}

// exampleResourcesPagerLabels is the shared pager vocabulary plus
// the per-number link name. Without it a screen reader hears only the digit,
// which in a row of digits says nothing about what the control does.
func exampleResourcesPagerLabels(ctx context.Context) ui.PagerLabels {
	labels := pagerLabels(ctx)
	labels.Page = func(page int) string { return i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.pagination_page", page) }
	return labels
}

templ ExampleResourceForm(d ExampleResourceFormData) {
	<div id="example-resource-form">
		if d.NameErr != "" {
			@ui.Notice(ui.NoticeOpts{Kind: ui.KindDanger, Live: ui.LiveAssertive, Attrs: ui.Attrs{Class: "mb-4"}}) {
				{ i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.fix_error") }
			}
		}
		@ui.Form(ui.FormOpts{
			Target: "#example-resource-form", Swap: "innerHTML",
			Attrs: ui.Attrs{
				Class:  "card max-w-lg space-y-4",
				TestID: "example-resource-form",
				HX:     ui.HX{Post: exampleResourceFormAction(d), Disable: true},
			},
		}) {
			@ui.Field(ui.FieldOpts{Name: "name", Label: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.field_name"), Error: d.NameErr, Required: true}) {
				@ui.TextInput(ui.TextInputOpts{
					Name: "name", Value: d.Name, Required: true, Error: d.NameErr,
					Placeholder: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.field_placeholder"),
				})
			}
			@ui.FormActions(ui.FormActionsOpts{Align: ui.AlignStart}) {
				@ui.Button(ui.ButtonOpts{
					Label: exampleResourceSubmitLabel(ctx, d), Type: ui.TypeSubmit, Action: ui.ActionPrimary,
				})
				// The indicator is a sibling, not a child of the button: htmx
				// flags the requesting element, so any .htmx-indicator inside it
				// shows, and the button keeps an accessible name that is only
				// its label.
				@ui.Spinner(ui.SpinnerOpts{})
				@ui.ButtonLink(ui.ButtonLinkOpts{Label: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.cancel"), Href: d.WriteURL})
			}
		}
	</div>
}

// ExampleResourceFormPage is the non-htmx 422 target: the form on its own
// page, so a client without JavaScript still sees the validation message.
templ ExampleResourceFormPage(d ExampleResourceFormData) {
	@ui.PageHeader(ui.PageHeaderOpts{Title: i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.title")})
	@ExampleResourceForm(d)
}

// exampleResourceFormAction posts to the collection for a create and to
// the row for an edit, which is the contract the handlers implement.
func exampleResourceFormAction(d ExampleResourceFormData) string {
	if d.ID == 0 {
		return d.WriteURL
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", d.WriteURL, d.ID)
}

func exampleResourceSubmitLabel(ctx context.Context, d ExampleResourceFormData) string {
	if d.ID == 0 {
		return i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.create")
	}
	return i18n.T(ctx, "example-resource.save")
}
